[[Budapest]] | capacity = 5,054 | chairman = [[László Markovits]] | manager = [[Gábor Erős]] | league = [[Nemzeti Bajnokság I|NB I]] | season = [[2025–26 Nemzeti Bajnokság II|2025–26]] | position = NB II, 1st of 16 (champion) | website = {{URL|vasasfc.hu}} | pattern_la1 = _vasas2223h | pattern_la2 = _adidascondivo20w | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b1 = _vasas2223h | pattern_b2 = _adidascondivo20w | pattern_b3 = | pattern_ra1 = _vasas2223h | pattern_ra2 = _adidascondivo20w | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_sh1 = _vasas2223h | pattern_sh2 = _adidascondivo20w | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so1 = _vasas2223h | pattern_so2 = _color_3_stripes_black | pattern_so3 = | leftarm1 = FF0000 | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | leftarm3 = | body1 = FF0000 | body2 = FFFFFF | body3 = | rightarm1 = FF0000 | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | rightarm3 = | shorts1 = FF0000 | shorts2 = FFFFFF | shorts3 = | socks1 = FF0000 | socks2 = FFFFFF | socks3 = | current = 2026–27 Vasas SC season }} {{Vasas SC sections}} '''Vasas SC''' ({{IPA|hu|ˈvɒʃɒʃ}}) is a Hungarian [[sports club]] based in [[Budapest]]. Members of the ''Hungarian Union of Iron Workers'' founded the club as ''Vas- és Fémmunkások Sport Clubja'', the "Sport Club of Iron and Metal Workers", on 16 March 1911. The club colours are red and blue. Most of its facilities are situated in [[13th district of Budapest|Budapest's 13th district]] in the north of the city. They have won the [[Hungarian League]] six times. Vasas is known internationally for reaching the semi-finals of the [[1957–58 European Cup]],{{cite web|url=http://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/season=1957/index.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110924061512/http://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/season=1957/index.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=24 September 2011|title=1957–58 UEFA European Cup|publisher=[[UEFA]]|date=6 May 2016|access-date=6 May 2016}} the quarter-finals in the [[1967–68 European Cup]] season,{{cite web|url=http://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/season=1967/index.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110924061527/http://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/season=1967/index.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=24 September 2011|title=1967–68 UEFA European Cup|publisher=[[UEFA]]|date=6 May 2016|access-date=6 May 2016}} and for being the most successful club in the [[Mitropa Cup]] with 6 championships."}}
